rival.name: {rival}
dialog: {player}! The statue's this way. Come on, come on!

cyrus.name: Cyrus
dialog: Time, space... and the Pokémon said to have made them. A myth worth looking into.

pokemon_breeder_m.name: Man
dialog: Nobody leaves Eterna without trying the Cycling Road.
You'll want wheels for it, mind. The cycle shop is just up the street.

expert_m.name: Old Man
dialog: Eterna City is nothing like the town I grew up in.
Back in my day, you could hear the forest from every street.

ninja_boy.name: Boy
dialog: Long ago, people really saw the Pokémon this statue shows. Can you imagine?
I stand here every day, in case it comes back.

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: Eterna's meant to be ancient, you know.
Funny, with all these tall blocks of flats about.
